text: I am born again by God's power, not human effort.
bibleVerseText: Children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband's will, but born of God.

text: I see Jesus' glory filling me with grace and truth.
bibleVerseText: We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.

text: I receive unlimited grace from Jesus' fullness — His well never runs dry.
bibleVerseText: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

text: I worship God with my whole heart and spirit in truth.
bibleVerseText: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth.

text: Doing God's will nourishes my soul — it is my daily bread.
bibleVerseText: But he said to them, 'I have food to eat that you know nothing about.' Then his disciples said to each other, 'Could someone have brought him food?' 'My food,' said Jesus, 'is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.'

text: God's will is my spiritual nourishment — I am fed from the inside out.
bibleVerseText: My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.

text: I have eternal life and will never be judged.
bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.

text: Jesus is the bread of life that satisfies me.
bibleVerseText: Then Jesus declared, 'I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.'

text: Jesus is the light that guides my path.
bibleVerseText: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, 'I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.'

text: Jesus is eternal and always with me — the great I AM is my constant companion.
bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, Jesus answered, before Abraham was born, I am!

text: Jesus is my door to salvation and abundance.
bibleVerseText: Therefore Jesus said again, 'Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.'

text: Jesus laid down His life for me — and I am the reason He did.
bibleVerseText: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

text: Jesus is my resurrection and eternal life — death has no hold on me.
bibleVerseText: Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.'

text: Whatever I ask in His name is done.
bibleVerseText: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

text: The Holy Spirit teaches me all things — I am never without wisdom or guidance.
bibleVerseText: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things.

text: I abide in the vine and bear much fruit.
bibleVerseText: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit.

text: My joy is complete in Him — full, deep, and unshakeable.
bibleVerseText: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.

text: I am Jesus' friend — He shares His heart with me and holds nothing back.
bibleVerseText: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master's business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

text: I overcome the world through Him — the battle is already won.
bibleVerseText: In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.

text: I have eternal life through believing — God so loved me that He gave everything.
bibleVerseText: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

text: I am born of the Spirit — a new creation with a heavenly origin.
bibleVerseText: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.

text: Jesus' truth sets me completely free — I know the truth and I live in it.
bibleVerseText: Jesus said, 'If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples. Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.'

text: I have life more abundantly — rich, full, and overflowing.
bibleVerseText: I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.

text: Rivers of living water flow from me — I am a source of life to everyone around me.
bibleVerseText: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.

text: I do greater works through Jesus — His power moves through me without limit.
bibleVerseText: Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things.

text: Whatever I ask in His name is done.
bibleVerseText: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

text: The Holy Spirit teaches me all things — I am never without wisdom or guidance.
bibleVerseText: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things.

text: I abide in the vine and bear much fruit.
bibleVerseText: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit.

text: My joy is complete in Him — full, deep, and unshakeable.
bibleVerseText: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.

text: I am Jesus' friend — He shares His heart with me and holds nothing back.
bibleVerseText: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master's business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

text: I overcome the world through Him — the battle is already won.
bibleVerseText: In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.

text: I am justified freely by God's grace — declared righteous without earning it, through redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
bibleVerseText: And all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

text: I boast even in my tribulations — because pressure produces endurance, and endurance produces proven character, and character produces hope.
bibleVerseText: Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance.

text: The love of God has been poured into my heart by the Holy Spirit.
bibleVerseText: And hope does not put us to shame, because God's love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit.

text: I am not defined by my worst moment but by God's greatest gift.
bibleVerseText: But where sin increased, grace increased all the more.

text: I am dead to sin and alive to God in Christ Jesus.
bibleVerseText: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

text: Sin has no dominion over me — I am under grace, not law.
bibleVerseText: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.

text: I am an instrument of right living surrendered to the hands of God.
bibleVerseText: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves of God, the benefit you reap leads to holiness, and the result is eternal life.

text: There is now no condemnation for me in Christ Jesus.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

text: When I don't know how to pray, the Holy Spirit intercedes for me.
bibleVerseText: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us through wordless groans.

text: Christ Himself intercedes for me at the right hand of God right now.
bibleVerseText: Who then is the one who condemns? No one. Christ Jesus who died more than that, who was raised to life is at the right hand of God and is also interceding for us.

text: I am predestined to be conformed to the image of Christ — this is God's plan.
bibleVerseText: For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.

text: If God is for me, no person or circumstance can stand against me.
bibleVerseText: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

text: God who gave His own Son will surely give me all I need.
bibleVerseText: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?

text: My feet are beautiful because I carry the good news of Jesus.
bibleVerseText: How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!

text: I am not squeezed into the world's mold.
bibleVerseText: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

text: I am not ashamed of the Gospel — it is the power of God for salvation.
bibleVerseText: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes.

text: I am justified by faith in the finished work of Jesus Christ.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: Every disappointment, detour, and loss is working together for my good.
bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

text: I am more than a conqueror through Him who loved me — not just surviving, but triumphantly overwhelming every obstacle.
bibleVerseText: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

text: Nothing in all creation can separate me from the love of God.
bibleVerseText: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers, neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: My body is a living offering to God — holy, acceptable, and wholly His.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice.

text: I am transformed by the renewing of my mind — daily I think differently, see differently, and live differently.
bibleVerseText: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

text: Faith comes by hearing and hearing by the Word of God.
bibleVerseText: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

text: I called on the name of the Lord and I was saved.
bibleVerseText: For, 'Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.'

text: I speak the deep wisdom of God that His Spirit reveals to me.
bibleVerseText: No, we declare God's wisdom, a mystery that has been hidden and that God destined for our glory before time began.

text: The Spirit in me searches the deep things of God — I access the mind of the Almighty.
bibleVerseText: These are the things God has revealed to us by his Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.

text: I am enriched in Christ in every way and I lack nothing.
bibleVerseText: For in him you have been enriched in every way with all kinds of speech and with all knowledge.

text: I plant and others water, but it is God who gives the increase.
bibleVerseText: I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God has been making it grow.

text: I build my life and ministry with gold, silver, and precious stones.
bibleVerseText: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay or straw, their work will be shown for what it is.

text: My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit.
bibleVerseText: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God?

text: I was bought at the price of Jesus' blood and I live for Him.
bibleVerseText: You are not your own; you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your bodies.

text: I have unique gifts given by the same Spirit — specific, necessary, and irreplaceable in the body of Christ.
bibleVerseText: There are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit distributes them.

text: I am part of Christ's one body — connected to every believer, each of us needed and irreplaceable.
bibleVerseText: Just as a body, though one, has many parts, but all its many parts form one body, so it is with Christ.

text: I walk the more excellent way — not through impressive gifts, but through love that never fails.
bibleVerseText: And yet I will show you the most excellent way.

text: Love is greater than every spiritual gift — prophecy fades, tongues cease, knowledge passes, but love never, ever fails.
bibleVerseText: If I speak in the tongues of men or of angels, but do not have love, I am only a resounding gong or a clanging cymbal.

text: Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
bibleVerseText: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

text: I grow in wisdom daily and I look forward to seeing Jesus face to face.
bibleVerseText: For now we see only a reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

text: Faith, hope, and love remain — the greatest is love, and love is who I am in Christ.
bibleVerseText: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.

text: I am raised incorruptible and clothed with immortality.
bibleVerseText: For the perishable must clothe itself with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.

text: Thanks be to God who gives me a victory I did not earn.
bibleVerseText: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: I am steadfast, immovable, and always abounding in the work of the Lord.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

text: As my sufferings increase, God's comfort increases even more — His care scales with every pain I carry.
bibleVerseText: For just as we share abundantly in the sufferings of Christ, so also our comfort abounds through Christ.

text: God establishes me, anoints me with His Spirit, and sets His seal of ownership on my life.
bibleVerseText: Now it is God who makes both us and you stand firm in Christ. He anointed us, set his seal of ownership on us, and put his Spirit in our hearts as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

text: I am a living letter from Christ.
bibleVerseText: You show that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God.

text: Where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
bibleVerseText: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

text: I behold the Lord's glory with an unveiled face and I am being transformed into His image from glory to glory.
bibleVerseText: And we all, who with unveiled faces contemplate the Lord's glory, are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory.

text: I carry extraordinary treasure in this ordinary body.
bibleVerseText: But we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.

text: I am hard pressed but not crushed — I do not go down alone.
bibleVerseText: We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair.

text: My inner self is being renewed day by day and I am not fading.
bibleVerseText: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.

text: I fix my eyes on the unseen eternal realities that outlast everything else.
bibleVerseText: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen, since what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

text: I have a building from God, eternal in the heavens, waiting for me.
bibleVerseText: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

text: To be absent from the body is to be present with the Lord.
bibleVerseText: We are confident, I say, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.

text: I live with eternity in mind and I stand before Christ unashamed.
bibleVerseText: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each of us may receive what is due us for the things done while in the body, whether good or bad.

text: The love of Christ compels me and I cannot stay silent about the cross.
bibleVerseText: For Christ's love compels us, because we are convinced that one died for all, and therefore all died.

text: I see Christ through spiritual eyes — He is Lord, alive, and reigning in my life.
bibleVerseText: So from now on we regard no one from a worldly point of view. Though we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.

text: I am reconciled to God and entrusted with the ministry of reconciliation — I carry the message that changes everything.
bibleVerseText: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation.

text: Now is the accepted time and today is the day of salvation.
bibleVerseText: I tell you, now is the time of God's favor, now is the day of salvation.

text: My life is a clear testimony — I walk with integrity so nothing hinders the Gospel.
bibleVerseText: We put no stumbling block in anyone's path, so that our ministry will not be discredited.

text: My approval comes from God alone — His voice is the only one that defines me.
bibleVerseText: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

text: I received my gospel by revelation of Jesus Christ.
bibleVerseText: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that the gospel I preached is not of human origin. I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

text: I live by faith in the Son of God.
bibleVerseText: The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

text: The law was my schoolmaster to bring me to Christ.
bibleVerseText: So the law was our guardian until Christ came that we might be justified by faith.

text: I have come of age in Christ and I live as a son, not a student earning approval.
bibleVerseText: Now that this faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.

text: I am a full child of God through faith in Christ Jesus — adopted, loved, and given complete inheritance rights.
bibleVerseText: So in Christ Jesus you are all children of God through faith.

text: I have put on Christ in baptism — I am clothed in Him, completely and forever.
bibleVerseText: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

text: In Christ all dividing walls are gone — I belong to one family, one Father, one hope.
bibleVerseText: There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

text: I am Abraham's seed and heir according to promise.
bibleVerseText: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

text: God sent His Son to redeem me from the law.
bibleVerseText: But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law, to redeem those under the law, that we might receive adoption to sonship.

text: God sent the Spirit of His Son into my heart.
bibleVerseText: Because you are his sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, 'Abba, Father.'

text: I am no longer a servant but a son and heir.
bibleVerseText: So you are no longer a slave, but God's child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

text: My true home is the heavenly Jerusalem — I am free, born from above, and no longer bound.
bibleVerseText: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.

text: I am born after the Spirit, not the flesh.
bibleVerseText: Now you, brothers and sisters, like Isaac, are children of promise.

text: The Spirit leads me and I am completely free from the burden of the law.
bibleVerseText: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

text: I live in the Spirit and walk in the Spirit.
bibleVerseText: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.

text: I bear in my body the marks of Jesus.
bibleVerseText: From now on, let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus.

text: As I have opportunity, I do good to all.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.

text: I do not grow weary in doing good. At the right time I reap.
bibleVerseText: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

text: What I sow in faithfulness, I reap in God's abundant blessings.
bibleVerseText: Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows.

text: Christ set me free — completely, permanently, powerfully — and I stay free.
bibleVerseText: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

text: I walk by the Spirit every day — sensitive to His voice, obedient to His nudges, yielded to His direction.
bibleVerseText: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

text: The fruit of the Spirit flows through me naturally — love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, and self-control.
bibleVerseText: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

text: I am crucified with Christ and yet I live.
bibleVerseText: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.

text: I sow into the Spirit and I reap life everlasting — my spiritual investments have eternal, abundant returns.
bibleVerseText: Whoever sows to please their flesh will reap destruction; whoever sows to please the Spirit will reap eternal life.
